datasets.name: ODSExchProvarch
datasets.sql:
SELECT 
      rownum,
      p.*,
      decode(p.status,'1', 'alış', '2','satış', '3', 'mübadilə') as status_str,
      decode(p.cashless,'0', 'nağd', '1','nağdsız') as status_cashless

FROM 
       ex_provarch p

WHERE
       p.ex_id = :ex_id


AND
       p.dat=:dat

AND
       p.status not in (4,5)


ORDER BY :Title

datasets.name: ODSReporting
datasets.sql:
select 
    p.ex_no,
    p.ex_name Ex_name,
   (select name from filial where id=p.filial) Filial,
    :val_name val_name,
    nvl((select decode(status,'1', 'alış')from ex_provarch where ex_id=p.ex_no and status=1 and trans_close=1 and dat between :bdat and :edat and VAL_ID=:val_id group by status),'alış') purchase,
    nvl((select round(sum(lamount)/sum(debitamount),6)from ex_provarch where ex_id=p.ex_no and status=1  and trans_close=1 and dat between :bdat and :edat and VAL_ID=:val_id),0) exchangerate,
    nvl((select sum(debitamount) from ex_provarch where ex_id=p.ex_no and status=1 and trans_close=1 and dat between :bdat and :edat and VAL_ID=:val_id ),0) purchaseamount,
    nvl((select count(id) from ex_provarch where ex_id=p.ex_no and status=1 and trans_close=1 and dat between :bdat and :edat and VAL_ID=:val_id ),0) purchasenumber,
    nvl((select  decode(status,'2','satış') from ex_provarch where ex_id=p.ex_no and status=2 and trans_close=1 and dat between :bdat and :edat and VAL_ID=:val_id group by status),'satış') sale,
    nvl((select round(sum(lamount)/sum(debitamount),6)from ex_provarch where ex_id=p.ex_no and status=2  and trans_close=1 and dat between :bdat and :edat and VAL_ID=:val_id),0) salecourse,
    nvl((select sum(debitamount) from ex_provarch where ex_id=p.ex_no and status=2 and trans_close=1 and dat between :bdat and :edat and VAL_ID=:val_id ),0)  salesamount,
    nvl((select count(id) from ex_provarch where ex_id=p.ex_no and status=2        and trans_close=1 and dat between :bdat and :edat and VAL_ID=:val_id ),0) salesnumber
from 
  ex_office p













order by ex_no

datasets.name: ODSExRemainderInsert
datasets.sql:
select  
 temprate.val_kod,
 nvl((select abs(ostat) from tenostat where acc_id=ex_accounts.selling_acc_id),0) ftpe_ostat,
 nvl((select abs(ostat) from tenostat where acc_id=ex_accounts.selling_acc_id),0) pefr_ostat,
 nvl((select abs(ostat) from tenostat where acc_id=ex_accounts.selling_acc_id),0) first_ostat,
 nvl((select obr_d from tenostat where acc_id=ex_accounts.selling_acc_id),0)purchase_turn,
 nvl((select obr_k from tenostat where acc_id=ex_accounts.selling_acc_id),0)selling_turn,
 nvl((select abs(ostat) from tenostat where acc_id=ex_accounts.selling_acc_id),0) current_ostat,
 :ex_id as ex_id,
 :dat as dat,
 :Tim as tim

from temprate 
     left join ex_accounts on  temprate.val_kod=ex_accounts.val_id and  ex_accounts.ex_id=:ex_id
where 

  temprate.val_kod<>0 

  

order by  temprate.val_kod

datasets.name: ODSReestrReport
datasets.sql:
select 
  val_name,
  nvl((select round(sum(lamount)/sum(debitamount),6) from  ex_provarch 
  where  dat=:dat  and  val_id=r.val_id  and ex_id=:ex_id and status=1 and trans_close=1),val_purchase_course)purchase,
  nvl((select sum(debitamount) from  ex_provarch where  dat=:dat  and  val_id=r.val_id  and ex_id=:ex_id and status=1 and trans_close=1),0) purchasenumber,
  nvl((select sum(debitamount) * round(sum(lamount)/sum(debitamount),6) from  ex_provarch 
  where  dat=:dat  and  val_id=r.val_id  and ex_id=:ex_id and status=1 and trans_close=1),0)purchaseamount, 
  nvl((select round(sum(lamount)/sum(debitamount),6) from  ex_provarch 
  where  dat=:dat  and  val_id=r.val_id  and ex_id=:ex_id and status=2 and trans_close=1),val_selling_course)salecourse,
  nvl((select sum(debitamount) from  ex_provarch where  dat=:dat  and  val_id=r.val_id  and ex_id=:ex_id and status=2 and trans_close=1),0) salenumber,
  nvl((select sum(debitamount) * round(sum(lamount)/sum(debitamount),6) from  ex_provarch 
  where  dat=:dat  and  val_id=r.val_id and ex_id=:ex_id and status=2 and trans_close=1),0)saleamount
from 
   ex_rates r
  where 
      dat=:dat and r.val_id in(select val_id from ex_provarch  where trans_close=1 and dat=:dat)
     and 
      r.val_id in(select val_id from ex_accounts where ex_id=:ex_id)






order by r.val_id
